review.readiness_note: The visible functionality appears intact, but visual sign-off is pending the missing Recreate output source. This capture cannot verify whole-composition link targets, downstream setup, publishing-credit checks, fees or payment mutations.

review.why: The supplied Lab is Business Home, not a Create specification, so the valid comparison is its visual language and the stated chooser composition. Production transfers the shell, neutral surfaces, typography hierarchy, source-ratio media and 24px source-to-decision offsets convincingly. All three campaign routes and the business navigation remain visible without clipping at 1440×900. Story shows creative on a phone, and Car correctly separates a real photograph from the placement diagram. Financial captions are appropriate to an unconfigured chooser. The material omission is Recreate’s creator-version source: explanatory copy alone does not complete the requested reference-to-output assembly.
review.verdict: Frame Shift is largely transferred and visible functionality survives, but complete Recreate’s missing creator-version source before signing off this viewport.
